description: Indirekteinleiter Abwasser is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. Indirect discharge point Waste water Indirect discharge; object under consideration in the GDZ; exported to GDZGDB.gdb; crime site describes a place where certain actions are carried out, in which case the direct discharge of waste water; this is the feature class GDT2010.wltoawde, exported to Filegeodatabase; The following user-relevant attributes are available: OBJART = type of ... Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Indirect discharge wastewater" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include WASSER_Indirekteinleiter, Ver- und Entsorgung/ Nachrichtenwesen, Saarland. The listing shows 2022-01-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
